notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue, a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any of the artifact tokens, adding {C}{C}.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.
